finding: A reproducible instrument and numerical counterevidence to our own finite confinement conjecture. No new theorem, extended verified RH range or benchmarked algorithmic improvement.
scopeLimit: This implements one precise moving-output-origin interpretation of the original idea; it does not exhaust every proposed point-relative construction. The exact dataset has not received an exhaustive novelty search.
possibleCriterion: A previously unreported branch connection, verified against prior literature and certified for the entire interval with existence, uniqueness and nonvanishing derivative bounds, could be a modest original bounded result. It would still require a separate argument to advance RH.
